intro: Kitimat’s home for the performing arts.
about: The Mount Elizabeth Theatre is Kitimat’s home for the performing arts. It is a joint-use facility of Coast Mountains School District 82 and the District of Kitimat. Our 500-seat auditorium is intimate and flexible, equally suited to musicals, concerts, dance, film, conferences, ceremonies and community gatherings. Performers and presenters can rely on professional sound and lighting, dedicated dressing rooms and a concert grand piano. Patrons enjoy accessible seating and on-site parking. The MET continues to evolve, driven by strong partnerships, and a shared vision of keeping live arts alive and accessible in Kitimat.

events.title: KCA Presents: Michael Kaeshammer
events.description: Pianist and songwriter Michael Kaeshammer brings his expressive, genre-spanning sound to the MET for a Kitimat Concert Association performance.

events.title: Full Circle (Taylor Bacharach)
events.description: A lighthearted documentary following Taylor Bacharach’s self-propelled canoe trip from Smithers through the Northwest.

events.title: KCA Presents: Burnstick
events.description: Burnstick is the folk duo of Jason and Nadia Burnstick. Lap slide guitar, poetic songwriting and close harmonies carry songs about love, loss and belonging.

events.title: KCA Presents: Casey Thomas
events.description: Casey Thomas brings a lively blend of Golden Age jazz and New Orleans spirit to the stage, with vocals and performances full of warmth and energy.

events.title: KCA Presents: Ollee Owens
events.description: Calgary-based Ollee Owens blends blues rock intensity with soulful vocals and songwriting for an emotionally charged live show.

events.title: KCA Presents: Ballet Jörgen – Swan Lake
events.description: Ballet Jörgen reimagines Swan Lake with a Canadian setting inspired by the Fortress of Louisbourg in Nova Scotia, while preserving the beauty and drama of the classical ballet.

events.title: KCA Presents: Krystle Dos Santos’ “A History of Motown”
events.description: Krystle Dos Santos presents A History of Motown, bringing her powerful voice and stage presence to the music and stories of the era.

events.title: Annual Community Telethon
events.description: Join us at the Mount Elizabeth Theatre on Sunday, October 18, for Kitimat’s Annual Community Telethon! Enjoy local talent, community spirit, and a live broadcast as we come together to support our community. Tune in, cheer on the performers, and help make this year’s telethon a success!
